reason: Changes are scoped to the Workflows editor client-side script/CSS (formatting + minor logic tweaks) and switching the script dependency from 'bootstrap' to 'admin' resource, which is low-risk but could subtly break the workflow editor UI if 'admin' doesn't transitively include bootstrap on some custom themes/tenants.
